name: enclosure_Static_events_N144_v1

screen.scope: One event-capture start versus two marker-free starts at the same trace and actual geometry. A point-estimate screen is not a statistical zero-interference guarantee. CUDA events enclose stream work and gaps. They are not exclusive kernel execution or physical kernel busy/idle. Failed screens remain diagnostic.

scope: Each figure uses one actual server start. Separate runs are not merged. No stream-ID, SM/HBM counter or physical idle claim. Event edges estimate stream enclosure boundaries, not individual kernel start/end.
